q1.sampleAnswer: It means the most popular and fashionable animal right now.

keyPoints.descZh: 指当下最受欢迎、最流行的动物
examples: the most popular animal right now
the most fashionable animal at the moment

q1.rubricZh: 要点：当下最受欢迎、最时髦的动物。
q1.explanationZh: 第一段说水豚是 the “it” animal of the moment，后面紧跟着说它们在全世界有几百万粉丝，所以意思是现在最火、最受欢迎的动物。

evidence.quote: They have millions of fans worldwide.

q2.sampleAnswer: They can buy capybara-themed T-shirts, cups, and stuffed animals.

keyPoints.descZh: 可以买水豚主题的T恤、杯子和毛绒玩具
examples: capybara-themed T-shirts, cups, and stuffed animals

q2.rubricZh: 要点：水豚主题的T恤、杯子、毛绒玩具（答出其中主要内容即可）。
q2.explanationZh: 第三段说这家店不卖咖啡，只卖水豚主题的T恤、杯子和毛绒玩具。

evidence.quote: It only sells capybara-themed T-shirts, cups, and stuffed animals.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because it allows visitors to have a closer connection with the capybaras than other places.

keyPoints.descZh: 它让游客能比其他地方更亲近水豚
examples: allows for the same close connection
a closer connection with the capybaras than other places

q3.rubricZh: 要点：比其他地方更能让人和水豚亲密接触。
q3.explanationZh: 最后一段说 Macri 认为别的动物园都比不上这里，这里能让人和水豚有最亲近的接触，所以她称赞这家咖啡馆。

evidence.quote: But Macri said that none of them allows for the same close connection with the animals as the Capybara Café does.

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I have. Capybaras are simply too cute. A nearby capybara café would help me, as well as many other people, relieve stress. (Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 明确表明态度（有 / 没有这样希望过）
给出至少一条合理理由
examples: It would help me relieve stress.

q4.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：先表明态度，再给出至少一条合理理由。
q4.explanationZh: 这是观点题，没有唯一答案。先说自己有没有这样希望过，再说理由，比如水豚很可爱、能减压，或者觉得不合适、对动物不好等。
